## Explicit test evidence and limitations
**Confirmed via live GitHub reads**: all 13 modified skill/contract files include the V2 active reference; registry is parseable JSON with 10 routes, 15 release gates and 20 adversarial probes; named runtime source and tests exist; workflow includes V2 test step; Stage 3 reports provisional status.

**Not verified**: results of the GitHub Actions runner; successful execution of entire Deck3/PPTX unit suite; full-text comparator-paper audits; real transformer/EVSE data, physical parameter admission, uncertainty calibration, field validation, authored raster source colors, all figure panel composition, Microsoft PowerPoint desktop click-playback. No claim of 100/100 scientific model quality or completion follows from this update.

**Known implementation blocker:** Deck3 runtime remains predominantly raster/PNG-oriented for Stage 2→3; the mixed original AI physical equipment + *native editable ports/arrows/equations* route and independent reveal playback require additional implementation (see [GitHub Issue #62](https://github.com/Dossiya-SE/MSE-thesis/issues/62)). Actual research falsification/evidence work is tracked in [Issue #65](https://github.com/Dossiya-SE/MSE-thesis/issues/65).

**Recommended next executable step:** run GitHub Actions tests and inspect logs; implement native hybrid figure assembly; apply G01–G15 and real full-text/mechanism review to the next selected 13-slide text before scientific release. Do not regenerate assets merely to claim this skills update complete.
